summary: Applied Optoelectronics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $600M of common stock through agents Raymond James and Needham & Company. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 415, with no fixed price, premium, or special-situation mechanics. Shares trade on Nasdaq under AAOI; last sale $223.10 on May 13, 2026. Agents receive up to 2.0% commission; there is no escrow or trust arrangement. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
